stem: Which sentence from the selection supports the idea that the Olympic rings symbolize each participant's home country?

options.label: F
options.text: A flag bearing five interlocking colored rings is lifted.

options.label: G
options.text: The symbol's message of unity, though, remains the same.

options.label: H
options.text: Each country competing in the games has at least one of the symbol's colors in its national flag.

options.label: J
options.text: The rings are now shown with three on top and two underneath, whereas originally they were interlocked in a single line.
